statement: Chaotic Efaunt is the second Chaotic Boss located in Djonnuttown at the end of Yum Desert
Needs minimum 2000 Accuracy for a 5% hit chance against Chaotic Efaunt
Needs 6000 Accuracy for 100% hit chance against Chaotic Efaunt
Fighting Chaotic Efaunt costs 5 Keys per attempt
He has two health bars of 100 million health each
Bring a character with significant damage to kill him in reasonable time
Recommends at least 200 Defense though it is still a bit of a struggle since he does a lot of damage
Bring plenty of food to fight this boss
Select the Chaotic Version when entering the boss
Hammer Swing hits the platform then the bottom platform; avoid by standing at platform edge or jumping to the small platform; easily tankable
Flame Orb spawns flames in a 1-2-3-4 pattern plus random flames; minor damage so no need to kill arm quickly
Finger gun spin does damage but unlike Normal version is not a one-shot so it is tankable
Leg kick hits the bottom section and a platform with significant damage so recommend killing that arm fairly quickly
Caress ability on the top right hand is melee range only so you can back off to avoid it
The grabbing motion over your head still hits for about 450 HP with 500 Defense
Psionic Wave shoots purple rings for meager damage; easily tanked and not a priority to kill
Scimitar swings hit all 3 melee platforms then a secondary slash only hits the bottom platform
Bottom platform is the highest damaging so kill that arm first
Abilities rotate in no particular order; killing an arm makes the other arms attack more frequently
Head phase only uses blue rings plus some from the ceiling; easily tankable with small defense so ignore them
Chaotic Efaunt can drop Gems if you have the Merit in the Tasks
Ripped Tunics are blue tunics also available in Normal Mode
Ribbed Tunics drop only from Chaotic Efaunt and are necessary to make the Chaotic Ring
He can drop the Efaunt Obol and Chaotic Efaunt card and Midnight Cookies
